repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-task
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for the Raindrop task service. It registers webex.internal.task, wraps the task REST operations (list, get, create, update, delete, accept, and reject) on catalog service raindrop, encrypts task title and notes with a KMS key before create and update and decrypts them in responses through webex.internal.encryption, and offers register and unregister calls that register the device, connect Mercury, and emit task:registered and task:unregistered without subscribing to any task event.

modules.coverage_evidence: Field coverage 93.3% (14/15) assessed 2026-10-09 by the generator; critical field coverage 8/8. The one WEAK field is test strategy: 17 unit tests cover request shapes for five REST methods, the happy register and unregister paths, and the helpers' basic branches, but no test exercises acceptTask, rejectTask, the register guards or failures, the existing-key encryption path, encryption or decryption failures, or caller-object mutation; the integration spec tests its own mock, and no characterization baseline exists. Independent validation is recorded in the module spec Validation status row. Held at Partial: weak test strategy, no characterization baseline, and no spec-drift record.

task-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-device, @webex/internal-plugin-encryption, and @webex/internal-plugin-conversation for their side effects and registers Task as the internal plugin 'task' with config {task: {}} and empty payload-transformer predicate and transform lists. The barrel src/index.js exports only Task as default. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

raindrop-tasks-http.source: Raindrop task service REST API (catalog service 'raindrop')
raindrop-tasks-http.summary: Consumed, not served. Calls GET tasks (query from the caller's options), GET tasks/{id}, POST tasks, PATCH tasks/{id}, DELETE tasks/{id}, POST tasks/{id}/accept, and POST tasks/{id}/reject on service raindrop. Request and response fields read by this package are listed under Protocol and wire format in src/docs/README.md.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host contract consumed by Task: WebexPlugin.extend supplies this.webex, this.logger, the ampersand event methods, and request(), which delegates to webex.request; registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin and merges its config; webex.canAuthorize gates register().

encryption-sdk.summary: The helpers call encryption.encryptText(keyUri, plaintext), encryption.decryptText(keyUri, ciphertext), and encryption.kms.createUnboundKeys({count: 1}). Key retrieval, caching, and the KMS exchange are owned by internal-plugin-encryption.

webex-device-registration.summary: register() calls webex.internal.device.register() before connecting Mercury. Imported for its registration side effect in src/index.js. Owned and specified by @webex/internal-plugin-device.

mercury-sdk.summary: register() calls webex.internal.mercury.connect() with no arguments. Not a declared dependency of this package; the plugin is registered transitively because internal-plugin-encryption's index imports it. Task subscribes to no Mercury event. Owned and specified by @webex/internal-plugin-mercury.

conversation-sdk.summary: Imported only for its registration side effect in src/index.js. Task calls no conversation method.

lodash.summary: src/helpers/encrypt.helper.js imports isArray to read the first key from createUnboundKeys.
